High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[Commander Nemet (V)]] (Virtual Set 3, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 3/Set 3 Dark/Commander Nemet.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPeYTlCN2NiVlF5ZXM/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Commander Nemet.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,339,200 bytes, SHA-256 <code>4a5f70f1dfeaef78b2f198a525b768e443b056588fb2686dfa6d5e85c07dc988</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:V3-D-commandernemet-2018-07-08.gif]].
